verdict.rationale: doola's docs describe outbound webhooks: signed POSTs carrying an X-Doola-Signature HMAC-SHA256 header keyed with your webhook secret. Sandbox-only endpoints fire the real webhooks for formation and EIN milestones, so a programmatic consumer can receive and test lifecycle events. missing for 10: documented endpoint registration and subscription management, a full event-type catalog, delivery and retry guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
